In this video, I got the chance to check out the new horror experience "Halloween: The Game" by Illfonic & Gun Interactive!
Play as the legendary Michael Myers or try your best to escape as a resident of Haddonfield.

Halloween: The Game is available September 4th for Deluxe Pre Orders & September 8th for standard.
